name: Leon S Kennedy's Big Day
source:
In Leon S Kennedy's Big Long Hard Oiled-up Day Out, you shockingly play as Leon Kennedy from the hit game series Resident Evil. You've just been dumped and it's time for you to go out on the town and try to forget the past.

Your decicions are extremely important.

Will you find new love? Stay trapped in the past? Die a tragic and sudden death?

Maybe even witness the elusive secret ending???????

[From [url=https://yeastqueen.itch.io/leonskennedys-big-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Leon S Kennedy's Big Long Hard Oiled-up Day Out》中，你将出人意料地扮演热门游戏系列《生化危机》中的里昂·S·肯尼迪。你刚刚被甩了，是时候进城走走，试着忘记过去。

你的决定至关重要。

你会找到新的爱情吗？会继续困在过去吗？还是会悲惨而突然地死去？

甚至有可能见证那个难以捉摸的秘密结局……？

[来自[url=https://yeastqueen.itch.io/leonskennedys-big-day]Itch.io[/url]]
